findings.evidence: TwentyFour.lean:41-42 vs TwentyFour.lean:145-146 ("a with centralizer of order 7680"); 31878 × 7680 = 244823040 = |M₂₄|, 21504 × 11385 = 244823040.
findings.fix: Drop the structure name: say the enumeration returns the index 31878 of the centralizer of the class 2B involution `a`, of order 7680 (2¹⁺⁶:L₃(2) is the 2A centralizer, index 11385).
findings.issue: The module docstring calls the index-31878 subgroup "the involution centralizer 2¹⁺⁶:L₃(2) of a class 2B involution in M₂₄". That is false and inconsistent with the file's own numbers: 244823040/31878 = 7680, whereas |2¹⁺⁶:L₃(2)| = 2⁷·168 = 21504, of index 11385. 7680 is the order the new `transcriptionNotes_m24Presentation` records for the centralizer of `a`.

findings.fix: In the M24 row's notes, quote the ATLAS page's Presentations section (heading and the seven displayed relations) so the source-to-Lean read-through can settle the conflict against the roadmap line, and flag the stale roadmap sentence for the humans.
findings.issue: The replacement paragraph asserts that `M₂₄` is transcribed from the ATLAS v3 presentation `M24G1-P1`, whose Magma file demonstrates it presents M₂₄. The roadmap states the opposite for this exact name: ATLAS v3 has a presentations section "for some sporadics (`M11`, `J1`) and none for others (`B`, `Co1`, `M24`, `HS`), where it offers standard generators and a semi-presentation instead", and warns that transcribing a semi-presentation as a presentation is the error this lane exists to catch. The transcribed words are clearly not the semi-presentation (they omit the standard-generator word `(ababab²abab²ab²)⁴` and include `[a,b]¹²`, `[a,bab]⁵`), so the roadmap line is probably stale — but the PR asserts the contrary without addressing it.

findings.evidence: TwentyFour.lean:65-69 vs TwentyThree.lean:64-65 and TwentyThree.lean:145-147; the commented-out eighth word `[a,b⁻¹abab]⁵` would add 5·(1+5+1+5) = 60, so a bracketed header would read 231 [or 291].
findings.fix: Quote the M24G1-P1.M header lines in the transcription notes as the M23 row does — either exhibiting a `Length:` figure to check 231 against, or showing that the header has none.
findings.issue: "Neither the presentation page nor the Magma source file records a length for this presentation" is asserted without evidence, while the sibling file of the same ATLAS series is quoted as carrying `Length: 190 [or 238].` and `NoRels: 8 [or 9].` in its header. If M24G1-P1.M carries the analogous header, `totalLength_m24Presentation = 231` is checkable against a published number and the row is silently skipping the very check this PR adds.

summary: The new equations, letter counts (238/190 for M23, 231 for M24) and cyclic-reducedness checks are all faithful — I recomputed every relator length from `Relator.length` and matched every annotation against its expression. Three provenance claims in the touched files are wrong or unresolved: a self-inconsistent centralizer identification in the M24 header, a direct conflict with the roadmap about whether ATLAS v3 has an M24 presentation at all, and an unverified assertion that the M24 Magma file records no length.
